item.title: The Silence of Space
item.description: The Or: Why Hollywood Decided Sound Was Optional But Also Mandatory The thing that bothers me about space movies isn’t the lasers. It isn’t the impossible maneuvers or the artificial gravity or the fact that nobody’s ship has ever run out of ammunition. It’s the sound. Specifically: the way space movies contain exactly as much sound as the plot requires, and no more, and also the wrong kind of sound, delivered at the wrong time, in the wrong medium, for the wrong physical reasons.
